title: Bully565
description: Mod with new Armor and Gear after Netherite.
body:
Some Overpowered Gear after Netherite. Have fun with the new Antimatter Equipment.
- Antimatter Scythe: Combination between Sword and Mace
- Antimatter Elytra: Moore Durability than the normal one.
- Antimatter Tools: More Durability and faster mining speed.
- Antimatter Armor: More Armorbars and mor Durability
